title: Keyboard and mouse controls
summary: Quick reference for the current Editor, Fly, and Walk controls.
outcome: You can use the correct controls for the focused mode and recover when movement stops.

sections.title: Editor mode
paragraphs: Select or deselect with Shift-click; select across objects with Shift-drag. With nothing selected, left-drag in a grid draws a brush. Otherwise, left-drag moves the selection. Right-drag orbits, middle-drag pans, and scroll zooms.

steps.title: Choose a tool
steps.text: Q creates brushes; S selects faces; E edits vertices; X clips brushes; T creates terrain; V sculpts terrain.

steps.title: Edit and navigate
steps.text: Use {mod}+S to save, {mod}+Z to undo, {mod}+Y to redo, Space to duplicate, Delete to delete, and End to frame selection.

tips: Shortcut keys act on the focused view; click the grid or camera if text entry has focus.

sections.title: Fly mode
paragraphs: Turn on Fly in the Camera header and focus the camera.

steps.title: Fly
steps.text: W/S move forward and back, A/D strafe, Q/E descend and ascend, Shift speeds up, right-drag looks around, and scroll moves forward or backward. Esc returns to Editor.

sections.title: Walk mode
paragraphs: Turn on Walk in the Camera header and focus the camera.

steps.title: Walk
steps.text: W/A/S/D move, Space jumps, right-drag looks, R resets to the entry position, and Esc returns to Editor. Click the camera to resume after focus loss.
